tasks.short: Supervise people engaged in music therapy activities

steps.what: Observe the actual music-therapy activity and the supervised person's handling of musical interaction and client response
inputs: actual supervised music-therapy activity
existing supervision objectives and professional boundaries
outputs: supervisor's actual musical-practice observations

steps.what: Give feedback, discuss actual client and musical responses, and agree next steps with the staff member, volunteer or trainee
inputs: supervisor's actual musical-practice observations
supervised person's actual account and questions
outputs: actual music-therapy supervision feedback and agreed next steps

steps.what: Write and check the existing supervision record with actual observations, feedback and agreed next steps
inputs: supervisor's actual musical-practice observations
actual music-therapy supervision feedback and agreed next steps
existing supervision identifiers
outputs: complete checked music-therapy supervision record

steps.what: Save the checked supervision record in the same learning record
inputs: complete checked music-therapy supervision record
outputs: saved actual music-therapy supervision record

tasks.design: Configure existing supervision identifiers and headings in {LMS}. The therapist observes actual musical practice, gives feedback and authors the supervision record; no system infers competence from participation or client reactions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision records may repeat identity fields and headings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native learning-record templates can reuse those nonjudgement fields.
tasks.still_hard: Interpret musical interaction and give fair feedback about actual practice.
tasks.human_edge: Coach the supervised person in context rather than score behavior automatically.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: music-therapy supervision involves actual observation and feedback; native supervision templates can reuse identifiers while the supervisor supplies substantive findings.

assumptions: LMS is the existing supervision record in a recorded practicum/staff-supervision scenario. Supervisor produces observations and feedback in s1-s2 and captures them in s3; no new recording or structured behavior capture is hidden.
Native headings first. Record checking stays inside ordinary authoring, with no added self-approval. If a population has no distinct supervision record, there is no setup saving to claim.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 0.7 minus 0.2 heading upkeep gives 0.5 net. Same-system save is 1% fully retained.
unknowns: Actual supervision record requirements and existing templates
research_questions: Does the existing record repeat metadata, and can native fields remove it without defaulting competence statements?

already_counted.description: Author and check actual supervision findings

approvals.approved_version: complete actual supervision record checked at end of s3; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if no distinct record or native fields already sufficient; cautious range below provisional 0.5% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review actual treatment goals, progress observations, current needs and continuity-of-care information
inputs: authorized actual therapy record and goals
actual progress observations and continuity information
outputs: therapist's source-checked termination-assessment context

steps.what: Discuss actual client concerns, preferences and responses to possible treatment termination
inputs: therapist's source-checked termination-assessment context
client's actual concerns and preferences
outputs: client's actual termination-related account and unresolved concerns

steps.what: Assess the specific risks, benefits and uncertainty of termination versus continued or alternative support
inputs: therapist's source-checked termination-assessment context
client's actual termination-related account and unresolved concerns
outputs: therapist's termination risk-benefit assessment and limitations

steps.what: Write and check the actual risk-benefit assessment, client concerns and unresolved continuity needs
inputs: therapist's termination risk-benefit assessment and limitations
client's actual termination-related account and unresolved concerns
outputs: complete checked termination-assessment record

steps.what: Save the checked assessment in the same therapy record without terminating treatment automatically
inputs: complete checked termination-assessment record
outputs: saved actual termination risk-benefit assessment

tasks.design: Configure a native view in {OPS_SYSTEM} linking actual goals, session observations and continuity information. The therapist checks sources, discusses the client's concerns and authors the termination assessment; the view does not recommend discharge or end treatment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant goals and progress evidence can require repeated record navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native care-record views can link existing sources with their dates.
tasks.still_hard: Assess the consequences of ending a therapeutic relationship for this client.
tasks.human_edge: Hear the client and judge unresolved support needs.

ambition.what: Improve source access without automatic termination decisions.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; clinical record access and care-team consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: termination assessment uses actual goals, progress and support context; native source views can reduce navigation without assessing the clinical tradeoff.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the therapy record. Actual clinicians and client accounts produce source evidence; no progress score or continuity plan is invented from session attendance.
Native linked view first. Clinical reading, client discussion, assessment and substantive record authoring remain. Task is assessment, not discharge processing or referral transmission.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 3 minus 0.4 view upkeep gives 2.6 net. Same-system save is 1% fully retained, with ordinary checking inside authoring.
unknowns: Actual navigation burden and availability of continuity information
research_questions: Does the linked native view remove navigation while preserving original dates, uncertainty and missing support information?

already_counted.description: Check actual source context for termination assessment

approvals.approved_version: complete termination assessment checked at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if sources already linked; cautious range below provisional 2.6% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Adapt or develop music-therapy assessment instruments for an individual client

steps.what: Assess the individual client's actual communication, motor, sensory and musical participation needs relevant to assessment
inputs: actual client capabilities and needs
authorized relevant clinical context
outputs: therapist's individual assessment-access requirements

steps.what: Review existing instruments, procedures and their intended interpretation before deciding what can be adapted
inputs: therapist's individual assessment-access requirements
actual authorized assessment materials and documentation
outputs: therapist's adaptation requirements and validity limitations

steps.what: Adapt the procedure or develop candidate assessment tasks that meet actual needs without assuming unchanged validity
inputs: therapist's adaptation requirements and validity limitations
actual authorized assessment materials and documentation
outputs: therapist-authored candidate assessment procedure

steps.what: Check practical accessibility and interpretive limitations of the candidate with actual observations or permitted trial use
inputs: therapist-authored candidate assessment procedure
actual client response during permitted trial or explicit trial-not-done status
outputs: therapist-checked usability findings and unresolved validity limits

steps.what: Finish and check the versioned procedure document with exact adaptations, actual usability findings and interpretation limits
inputs: therapist-authored candidate assessment procedure
therapist-checked usability findings and unresolved validity limits
existing document version fields
outputs: complete checked adapted assessment procedure with explicit limitations

steps.what: Save the checked procedure version in the existing assessment document store
inputs: complete checked adapted assessment procedure with explicit limitations
outputs: saved adapted assessment procedure and its limitations

tasks.design: Use native version and limitations headings in {DOCS} for the therapist-authored assessment procedure. The therapist assesses actual needs, designs adaptations and checks usability; document reuse does not establish psychometric validity or replace individual clinical judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finishing an adapted procedure can repeat version fields and limitation headings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates can reuse those fields while retaining explicit adaptation history.
tasks.still_hard: Adapt access without making unsupported assumptions about what results mean.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when an adaptation changes interpretability.

ambition.what: Reduce small document setup work, not automate assessment design.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: adapting an assessment can change interpretability; document templates preserve version and limitation fields but do not validate the adapted instrument.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM supplies actual authorized clinical context; DOCS holds assessment materials. Therapist produces requirements, candidate procedure and actual usability findings. A trial requires the applicable permission; absent trial remains explicit.
Native document reuse first; no model generates or validates a clinical instrument. The scenario ends with a checked procedure and limitations, not a claim of validation or a clinical result.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 0.9 minus 0.2 template upkeep gives 0.7 net. Substantive assessment work and 1% save remain fully retained.
unknowns: Actual instrument permissions, interpretation limits and document setup burden
research_questions: Can native version fields reduce repeated setup while making every changed procedure and validity limitation clear?

already_counted.description: Finish and check exact adaptations and limitations

approvals.approved_version: complete adapted procedure and limitations checked at end of s5; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if native document fields already suffice; cautious range below provisional 0.7% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Apply current technology within actual music-therapy practice

steps.what: Assess the actual therapeutic purpose, client access needs and suitability of the available music technology
inputs: actual therapeutic purpose and client access needs
available approved music technology and its documented controls
outputs: therapist's selected appropriate technology use and constraints

steps.what: Configure and finish checking the exact session settings, reusing an existing suitable preset where appropriate
inputs: therapist's selected appropriate technology use and constraints
existing therapist-checked settings presets
actual device and interface configuration
outputs: complete checked session technology settings and intended device

steps.what: Apply the exact checked settings to the intended session device
inputs: complete checked session technology settings and intended device
outputs: checked settings applied to the intended session device

steps.what: Use the selected technology during the actual music-therapy practice and adapt support to the client's response
inputs: checked settings applied to the intended session device
client's actual interaction and response
outputs: actual technology-supported musical interaction and observed response

steps.what: Evaluate actual accessibility and therapeutic usefulness, retaining limitations and stopping unsuitable use
inputs: actual technology-supported musical interaction and observed response
therapist's selected appropriate technology use and constraints
outputs: therapist's actual technology-use evaluation and next-use decision

tasks.design: Reuse native session presets in {OTHER}, the approved accessible music-making device or software. The therapist checks the actual device and settings before applying them, supports the client's use and evaluates the real response; no adaptive clinical control is delegated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated setup of suitable device/interface settings can take attention before use.
tasks.enabler_now: Native presets can reuse known settings with an actual session check.
tasks.still_hard: Determine whether the technology helps this client rather than distracting or excluding them.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt musical interaction and access support to actual response.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated device setup while retaining technology selection and clinical use.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: music-making software and devices can store session presets; therapists must check device suitability and actual client response.

assumptions: OTHER is the existing approved accessible music-making technology. Therapist supplies purpose and constraints in s1; actual known presets supply reusable settings, checked in s2. No new patient telemetry or model inference.

Native presets first. This task owns device setup/use, not an additional session-note baseline; any actual shared clinical note is counted once in session documentation. No new preset-writing action is claimed.

Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 4.8 minus 0.8 preset compatibility upkeep gives 4 net. Applying settings is 1% fully retained; device runtime and the actual therapy interaction earn no saving.
unknowns: Device preset support and actual repeated setup effort
research_questions: Can existing presets reduce setup while preserving device identity, accessibility and a fresh session check?

already_counted.description: Configure and check exact session settings

incremental.description: Maintain preset compatibility after device or software changes

approvals.approved_version: exact session settings and device checked at end of s2; changes void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if presets already used or unsuitable; cautious range below provisional 4% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Clinical teams retain termination and assessment responsibilities; technology owners support approved device access.
skills_to_grow: Observe musical practice and give grounded feedback
Check native device presets against actual session needs
role.ambitious_version: Reduce verified repeated document and device setup while preserving supervision, termination judgement and individualized assessment design.
